title: API-First Agentic OS
description: 91 REST endpoints covering chat, sessions, admin, profiles, skills, metrics, and webhooks. Build any frontend on top.

title: Multi-Tenant by Design
description: One 31MB binary serves 200+ profiles on a 16GB machine. Each profile runs as a separate OS process with isolated memory, sessions, and data.

title: Multi-LLM Pipelines
description: Define workflows as DOT graphs with per-node model selection. Dynamic parallel fan-out spawns N concurrent workers at runtime.

title: 3-Layer Provider Failover
description: RetryProvider, ProviderChain, and AdaptiveRouter with hedge racing, lane scoring, and circuit breakers. Your agents never go down.

title: LRU Tool Deferral
description: 15 active tools for fast LLM reasoning, 34+ available on demand. Idle tools auto-evict to keep context windows lean.

title: 5 Queue Modes
description: Followup, Collect, Steer, Interrupt, and Speculative — control how your agent handles concurrent messages per session.

title: 3-Layer Memory System
description: Long-term entity bank with auto-injection, episodic task outcomes in redb, and session history with JSONL plus LLM compaction.

title: Native Office Suite
description: Generate PPTX, DOCX, and XLSX from pure Rust — zip and quick-xml with zero external dependencies.

title: Sandbox Isolation
description: bwrap, sandbox-exec, and Docker support. Workspace-wide deny(unsafe_code) with 67 prompt injection tests.
